baseline.linker: excluded because 2/4/6-frame study already yielded 7/7/5 versus baseline 7

method.approach: compress only the pre-contact approach segment
method.closing: shift the original closing commands earlier without changing their order
method.settle: repeat the final pre-lift closed command for 2 or 4 frames
method.lift: preserve every original frame from lift_start onward exactly

range_reason.2_frames: minimum meaningful 0.1 s contact stabilization at the 20 Hz demonstration rate
range_reason.4_frames: tests a moderate 0.2 s settle while avoiding the 6-frame setting that increased action jumps and hurt Linker
range_reason.no_larger_search: larger holds consume more approach time and the prior Linker ablation already contradicts monotonic benefit

selection_rule: within each hand, require success_count above the current A baseline and positive paired net gain; ties favor 2 frames; only one global setting can enter D

physics_results_A.decision: reject all candidates; additional pre-lift settling increases contacts in some cases but reduces lift success
